parts.label: Engine-to-Transaxle Adapter / Bellhousing Interface
parts.function: Adapter / bellhousing interface mating the mid-mounted flat-six to the rear transaxle — PDK dual-clutch or 6-speed manual on the 987.2, Tiptronic S or 5/6-speed manual on the 987.1.

parts.label: Engine Mounts x2 — Hydraulic Rubber Mounts
parts.function: Pair of hydraulic rubber engine mounts isolating the mid-mounted flat-six from the chassis. Tired mounts show up as clunks on throttle lift and gear changes — a common 987 age item.

parts.label: Transaxle / Transmission Mount
parts.function: Rubber mount supporting the rear of the transaxle (PDK, Tiptronic S or manual) against the rear subframe, completing the three-point drivetrain suspension.

parts.label: Differential / Final Drive Housing
parts.function: Final-drive differential integrated in the transaxle with the half-shaft output flanges. A mechanical rear differential lock was optional on the 987.2 (paired with adapted rear anti-roll bars, 2009 Service Introduction).

parts.label: Rear Drive Shaft / Half-Shaft (Left)
parts.function: Left rear half-shaft from the transaxle output flange to the rear wheel hub, with inner and outer constant-velocity joints and protective bellows.

parts.label: Rear Drive Shaft / Half-Shaft (Right)
parts.function: Right rear half-shaft from the transaxle output flange to the rear wheel hub, with inner and outer constant-velocity joints and protective bellows.

parts.label: Inner CV Joints (Transaxle Side) x2
parts.function: Constant-velocity joints at the transaxle flanges accommodating drivetrain movement; bolted to the output flanges with socket-head screws.

parts.label: Outer CV Joints (Wheel Side) x2
parts.function: Constant-velocity joints at the wheel carrier / hub end of each rear drive shaft, following the McPherson rear axle through bump and rebound travel.

parts.label: CV Joint Bellows / Boots x4
parts.function: Corrugated protective bellows over the inner and outer CV joints retaining grease and excluding grit — a split boot (clicking on full lock) is the classic 987 drive-shaft failure mode; inspect yearly.

parts.label: Lug Bolts M14x1.5 Ball-Seat x20
parts.function: Set of M14x1.5 ball-seat lug bolts securing the wheels to the hub flanges; torqued to 130 Nm in a star pattern.
